name: Anthony Timpano
bio: Anthony Timpano is an actor, known for A Score to Settle (2019), There's Someone Inside Your House (2021) and Mixtape (2021).

credits.title: A Long Winter
credits.overview: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

credits.title: One Mile: Chapter One
credits.overview: After being released from special forces, a father tries to reconnect with his daughter by taking her on a tour of college, but they soon find themselves fighting for more than their lost relationship when a murderous cult pursues them.

credits.title: An Unexpected Valentine
credits.overview: A chance encounter on Valentine's Day brings Hannah and Finn together as they race through New York City to return a lost engagement ring and save one couple's special day.

credits.title: Friday Night Sext Scandal
credits.overview: High school football players conspire to post nude images of their female classmates on a covert website. When the site is discovered, members of the community try to expose the culprits, only to learn the devastating truth about those involved.

credits.title: A Christmas for the Ages
credits.overview: Prompted by their youngest granddaughter, four generations celebrate family and what Christmas was like in the '40s, '60s, '90s, and present day.

credits.title: My Christmas Hero
credits.overview: Nicole Ramsey is dedicated to serving military service members and their families at the Joint Military Base in Lacey, Washington, home of I Corps and the 62nd Airlift Wing. credits.title: Trap House
credits.overview: When a drug epidemic ravages the city, Detective Grant Pierce decides to take matters into his own hands, going undercover to infiltrate the infamous "Trap House": a madman's meth lab outfitted with lethal and sadistic booby traps.

credits.title: Sugar
credits.overview: Inspired by the dramatic true story of the Cocaine Cowgirls, Sugar follows two young Canadian women who get caught up in a major drug smuggling operation aboard a luxury cruise ship sailing around the world. With nowhere to run—the walls close in on them.

credits.title: Wasiat Terakhir
credits.overview: Rayan is the adopted son of Mr. Hardi, but because he is overly pampered, Rayan becomes a spendthrift and an irresponsible person. What happens?

credits.title: Mixtape
credits.overview: On the eve of Y2K, orphaned 12-year-old Beverly discovers a broken mixtape crafted by her teen parents. Raised by her grandmother – who struggles talking about her late daughter – Beverly sees the mixtape as a chance to finally learn more about her parents.

credits.overview: As the countdown to graduation begins, students at Osborne High are being stalked by a maniac intent on exposing their darkest secrets to the entire town, terrorizing victims while wearing a life-like mask of their own face. credits.overview: Hanna Brooks is the new girl in town who is looking to find her place and fit in at Lakewood High School, which was rocked a couple of years earlier by the shocking drug overdose of a popular student. credits.title: Secrets of a Gold Digger Killer
credits.overview: Multimillionaire Steven Beard, a retired broadcasting executive, who fell hard for Celeste , an attractive waitress who served him his nightly cocktail at the local country club in Austin, Texas.

credits.title: It Was Always You
credits.overview: Elizabeth's engagement plans are thrown into disarray when her fiancée's free-spirited brother David returns home. David's unexpected influence prompts Elizabeth to question her life decisions.

credits.overview: As Christina prepares her restaurant for its busiest time of year, she gets back a DNA test revealing that she’s Jewish. The discovery leads her to a new family and an unlikely romance over eight nights.

credits.overview: A former mob enforcer who is released from prison after serving 22 years for a crime he didn't commit sets out on a path for revenge against the people who wronged him.
